mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_SKIN_IMG (USER_SKIN_IMG_ID, USER_ID, IMG) VALUES (seq_user_skin_img.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{img})
mapper.select: SELECT t1.USER_SKIN_IMG_ID AS userSkinImgId, t1.USER_ID AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, t1.IMG AS img, t1.BDATE AS bdate FROM USER_SKIN_IMG t1 JOIN USERS u ON t1.user_id = u.user_id WHERE t1.bdate = ( SELECT MAX(t2.bdate) FROM USER_SKIN_IMG t2 WHERE t2.user_id = t1.user_id )
